summary: Frontend-only verification of the 4 Review-Mode fixes on the preview URL (auth bypassed, dev@local Owner). ALL FOUR FIXES PASS functionally. (1) CONTRAST/DARK on /review/what-is-emergent: dark theme -> page bg rgb(9,9,11), body paragraph color rgb(212,212,216) = 13.46:1 contrast; h1 rgb(255,255,255) = 19.90:1. Light theme -> p rgb(9,9,11) on rgb(255,255,255) = 19.90:1. No white-on-white anywhere in the doc body. theme-toggle in the review header flips html.dark, writes localStorage 'emergent-theme' and survives a full reload. (2) PUBLISH LINK FIX: /admin/review -> Publish tab renders 121 publish-title-<id> buttons; clicking the first ('What is Emergent?') navigated to /review/what-is-emergent (NOT /admin/editor/...) and review-page rendered. The separate review-doc-<id> ('Review page /') button also goes to /review/<slug>. (3) REVIEWER FILTER: created 3 page assignments via UI (assign-scope-search + assign-option-page-* + assign-email + assign-submit): what-is-emergent -> alice@emergent.sh, forking -> alice@emergent.sh, the-universal-llm-key -> bob@emergent.sh. Filter 'alice' -> exactly 2 rows, both alice; 'bob@emergent.sh' -> exactly 1 row; unknown email -> 0 rows + assign-empty visible with text 'No reviews match that email.'; 'Clear' resets the input and restores all 21 rows. (4) DARK CONSOLE: theme-toggle in console header works; body/root bg rgb(9,9,11) across Overview/Assignments/Inbox/Publish, cards zinc-900, inputs zinc-800 with light text - BUT several elements were never given dark: variants and are effectively unreadable (details in design_issues, ratios 1.7-2.29). REGRESSION in dark mode: verdict chip reviewpage-verdict-Needs-small-edits saved (toast 'Verdict saved') and persisted inverted (bg white / text zinc-900) after reload; Range-based text selection produced selection-comment-btn -> composer (input bg rgb(39,39,42) / text rgb(244,244,245)) -> comment pinned with quoted anchor into review-comments-rail (body color rgb(228,228,231) on rgb(9,9,11)); cascade multi-select in dark: tab 'Learn the Basics' -> '18 item(s) selected' with all 3 section checkboxes checked, re-click clears. 0 JS console errors (only a benign 404 for a static asset on every page). CLEANUP: my 3 assignments, the TEST_ comment and the verdict deleted via API/pymongo - verified 0 comments / 0 verdicts on what-is-emergent, 0 published docs. NOTE: 18 pre-existing assignments for vishal.k@emergent.sh were already in the DB (not created by me, left untouched).

ui_bugs.issue: DARK MODE UNREADABLE: section labels use text-zinc-700 (contrast 1.70:1) and tab labels text-indigo-700 (2.24:1) on the zinc-900 card with no dark: variants. The scope picker is practically invisible in dark mode, blocking assignment creation. Needs dark:text-zinc-300 / dark:text-indigo-400. Row hover also uses hover:bg-zinc-50 with no dark variant (flashes near-white).

DARK MODE: bg-zinc-900 primary buttons sit on dark:bg-zinc-900 cards, so the button loses all shape and reads as plain white text (visually confirmed on the Publish tab and New assignment card). Needs dark:bg-white dark:text-zinc-900 (or dark:bg-indigo-600).
DARK MODE: text-indigo-700 on zinc-900 = 2.24:1 (x8 rows measured on the Publish tab). Needs dark:text-indigo-400 + dark:border-indigo-500/40.
DARK MODE: 'Delegate' / 'Reopen' text-zinc-600 on zinc-900 = 2.29:1 (10 occurrences); hover:bg-zinc-50 / hover:bg-emerald-50 / hover:bg-rose-50 have no dark variants.

critical_code_review_comments: ReviewConsole.jsx is 483 lines with the whole 4-tab console inline; the dark-mode misses found are a direct consequence - split into ReviewOverview/ReviewAssignments/ReviewInbox/ReviewPublish and centralise chip/button styles so a theme variant can't be forgotten in one branch.

Colour utilities are hardcoded per element instead of using the design tokens (hsl(var(--foreground)) etc.) that ReviewPage/DocContent uses correctly - that is exactly why ReviewPage passes contrast and ReviewConsole does not.

The reviewer filter is a pure client-side .filter() over all assignments; fine now, but once the assignment list grows past a page this must move to the API (?assignee_email=) - and reviewer-scoped filtering must be server-enforced when auth is re-enabled, since the current filter is cosmetic only.

rca_of_the_issue: All 4 reported fixes are correctly implemented. ReviewPage.jsx delegates body text colour to .doc-content { color: hsl(var(--foreground)) } which flips with html.dark, so the original white-on-white is genuinely gone (13.46:1 dark / 19.90:1 light). The remaining problem is scoped to ReviewConsole.jsx: dark: variants were added to containers, cards, borders and inputs but NOT to a set of inner text/button utilities (text-zinc-600/700, text-indigo-700, bg-zinc-100 chips, bg-zinc-900 buttons, hover:bg-*-50), producing 1.70-2.29:1 contrast in dark mode - worst case the assign-scope-list, which makes creating an assignment impractical while dark mode is on.
